name: @wocwang/cortico-world-rvc-for-coopanion
description: Cortico World for Coopanion: voice conversion with RVC — upload any audio and get it back in the pet's voice, plus a local HTTP endpoint (127.0.0.1:9881) for other plugins
author: wocwang

zh.description: 把任意一段音频换成桌宠的音色：上传音频、可选变调、试听与落盘，全程在本机推理。内置公开示例音色（大肥鱼，MIT），也支持导入自备 .pth / .index。另开一个只监听本机的 HTTP 接口（默认 127.0.0.1:9881），其他插件可以用 POST /convert 直接拿到变声后的音频。只做推理，不做训练。

en.description: Turns any audio clip into the pet's voice: upload, optional pitch shift, preview and save, all inferred on your own machine. Ships a public sample voice (DaFeiYu, MIT) and accepts your own .pth / .index. Also serves a loopback-only HTTP endpoint (127.0.0.1:9881 by default) so other plugins can POST /convert and get the converted audio back. Inference only, no training.

scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run build && npm test && npm run typecheck
